source.text:
2 Piece | Resupply

Scoring a kill spawns an Orb of Power on the Enemy that grants 0.875% Super Energy, as well as +20% Special Ammo Progress and +20% Heavy Ammo Progress.
Incurs a 12 second cooldown before it can retrigger.
